title: Raku Firing Workshop
cost_text: $20 materials fee payable to the instructor
summary: Two-part raku workshop where you sculpt a piece in Part 1 and glaze and fire your own work in Part 2, removing red-hot pieces from the kiln and placing them into combustibles. No experience necessary; all tools and materials provided.
source_quote: Raku Firing. In this two-part workshop, you'll explore the dramatic and hands-on process of raku firing. In Part 1, you'll sculpt a piece in clay and watch a live raku firing demo. Three weeks later in Part 2, you'll glaze and fire your own work using the raku method—removing red-hot pieces from the kiln and placing them into combustibles for stunning, unpredictable results. October 10 & 17, 1-4 pm
evidence_sentence: A two-part raku workshop teaches participants to glaze and fire their own work using the raku method.
evidence_quote: you'll glaze and fire your own work using the raku method
